name: agentui-tools
description: Build and host real apps with AgentUI — hosted database, auth, file storage, serverless endpoints, cron automations, standalone MCP servers and API integrations — all driven from the agentui CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Build and host real apps — database, auth, storage, MCP servers.
interface.longDescription: Wraps the agentui CLI in eight model-invoked skills, so instead of scaffolding a local project nobody can open, Codex returns a working URL — with a hosted Postgres database, user logins, file uploads and an /api. Covers shipping an app, entity schemas and row-level security, workspace file storage, cron and webhook automations, API integrations, and custom MCP servers including standalone ones. Requires the agentui CLI (npm install -g @agentuiai/cli) and an AgentUI account.
